# Fixed-row pointer SIMD residual gather

Native Apple M4 Max,Go1.27.2 archsimd,PGOoff,GOMAXPROCS1. Parent03afac7c
merged as9f333e01 with identical tree; pinned assembly691cd051. The looped
pointer predecessor already gave1.5x representative gains and remains fully
preserved in the separate looped-gather archive. Fixed row groups remove its
loop address setup while retaining exact paired-row arithmetic/store order.
Guards, input/output bounds and aliases keep the same proven pointer contract.

Fresh six balanced main/ASM/current permutations, with the looped predecessor
as an additional first/last alternating control. All four binaries use exactly
the same18 public-operation fixtures: original two, eight unaligned/minimal
row windows with unequal padded strides, and eight tightly packed predictors;
random and extreme values. New fixtures check all coefficients with independent
scalar equations, full input immutability and output canaries after B.Loop.
150ms per fixture, zero bytes and allocations in every sample.

8x8: 1.9598–2.1740x main; 1.1035–1.3026x assembly; 1.2858–1.4137x the looped pointer version.

16x16: 1.6631–1.8438x main; 1.5232–1.5883x assembly; 1.0670–1.1706x the looped pointer version.

All108 paired samples beat main by at least 1.630x and beat assembly. Keep these verified component wins independently of overall codec results under AGENTS.md. Every raw sample/outlier and the earlier diagnostic remain archived.

Whole synthetic720p VP8,realtimeCPU8,2500kbps,one thread,six fresh balanced three-way permutations using the final root binary:

* 300frames: -0.790% encode time versus main (6/6 faster), +9.600% versus assembly (0/6 faster).

* 60frames: -0.936% encode time versus main (5/6 faster), +12.068% versus assembly (0/6 faster).

All23 non-timing result fields match and allocations stay zero. Whole and
component results remain separate; the overall ARM assembly gap is still open.

Validation: full native ./...,336 public repeated/overlapping-row, alignment
and extreme cases plus existing randomized/minimal-window oracles; explicit
successful helper assertions with mutually aliased read-only inputs; nil,
stride1<<48/negative and disabled declines; race/checkptr2; six fixed-speed
packet bytes/drop-position digests exactly matching parent; refreshed PGO and
fingerprint/noasm/build-selection/precommit. The first fixed-packet command
matched no tests (plural typo); its log is retained and the corrected singular
run executes all six cases. No empty-run claim is used.

Final ARM hot instruction words exactly match the timed prototype:108 lines
for8x8 and282 for16x16. Only leading addresses and in-function absolute branch
renderings are normalized; raw instruction words also compare exactly.
Both ARM functions are leaf code without bounds-panic calls. AMD cross-codegen
uses146/399 instruction lines, no bounds-panic or arithmetic calls;16x16 has a
cold stack-growth call and stack scratch for row addresses. These counts are
diagnostics, not acceptance criteria or native x64 performance claims.
AMD selected/actualAVX-off arithmetic and all18 fixture checks pass under
Rosetta for correctness only. Native x64 CI measures the final production
candidate before merge. No README or dependency changes.

# Native x64 vertical-filter candidate

Parent03afac7c. The previous AMD wrapper declines vertical macro/internal
fusion, so the picker invokes separate macro and internal filter networks.
Generate a vertical combined network from the same canonical arithmetic,
using the existing exact4-byte column packing and carrying modified neighbors.
Capture it before ARM-specific TRN,packed-row and rounded-zero transforms.
ARM generated source and existing AMD horizontal function stay byte-identical.

Initialcols0..7, macrostores1..6, correctedcarry4..7, internaledges8/12/16:
store6..9/10..13/14..17, then load8..11/12..15/16..19 after prior stores.
Maximumaddress19+15*pitch matches the pre-multiplication wrapper proof.
Pitch>=20 prevents row aliasing; masked-off edges keep original carried q.
The existing AVX cleanup and runtime-disable-before-access checks remain.

Expanded pixel oracle covers both orientations (7200 numeric/alignment cases),
independent DSP oracle now covers vertical too, and runtime-disabled guards
check both shapes. Selected AMD correctness passes under Rosetta only; no
emulated speed is used. Independent read-only review finds no correctness
issue. The generated vertical body has1015 instruction lines and calls only
its existing column-load helper plus runtime stack growth; diagnostics do not
establish a speedup. Native x64 CI must measure this candidate before merge.
All old fixtures are retained to expose public/whole regressions. The previous
native EPYC7763 profile samples loopFilterBytes at0.12sflat/0.48scumulative
out of2.36s total; this target selection is qualitative, not causal evidence.
Initial generator concatenation lacked a newline; fixed retry and all logs
are preserved. No README or dependency changes.

pr_snapshot.body:
VP8 residual gathers rebuild dynamic slices and check each SIMD window even though their pointer API already requires complete input/output blocks. Use exact pointer loads and stores with fixed row groups, retaining the paired-row 4×4 block-scan arithmetic, read-only input aliases, and existing fallback behavior. Separately, enable generated x64 vertical macroblock/internal filter fusion with exact carried neighbors and a checked 20×16 window; ARM's filter network stays unchanged.

Native Apple M4 Max, Go 1.27.2 SIMD, PGO off, six fresh balanced main/assembly/current permutations plus the looped pointer predecessor:

- **8×8 gather: 1.960–2.174× main, 1.104–1.303× assembly.**
- **16×16 gather: 1.663–1.844× main, 1.523–1.588× assembly.**
- All **108 paired samples** exceed **1.630× main** and beat assembly, with zero allocations. Fixtures cover unaligned minimal rows, unequal padded strides, packed predictors, and random/extreme values with full scalar/output-guard checks.
- Whole VP8 720p/300 frames: **−0.790% encode time versus main**, all 6 pairs faster; still **+9.600% versus assembly**.
- Whole VP8 720p/60 frames: **−0.936% versus main**, 5/6 faster; still **+12.068% versus assembly**.

All 23 non-timing encoder fields match and allocations stay zero. Keep these correctness-verified component wins independently of whole-codec performance under AGENTS.md. The overall ARM assembly gap remains open.

Validation: full native suite; existing randomized/extreme/minimal-window oracles; 336 new public row cases; direct selected-path/input-alias/decline tests; race/checkptr2; six exact packet/drop digest comparisons; independent pointer/filter reviews; regenerated PGO and fingerprint/noasm/build-selection/precommit gates. Final ARM instruction words exactly match the timed prototype (108/282 lines). Rosetta verifies x64 correctness only, including the expanded vertical scalar oracles, all 18 gather fixtures, and actual AVX-disabled fallback. Native x64 results follow below; instruction counts and stack scratch remain diagnostics rather than acceptance criteria.

Expand identical native x64 fixtures from 190 to 206, require the new selected-path/public-row tests, record source hashes, and allow 35 minutes for the larger job. Preserve the earlier 1.5× looped-gather evidence and smaller UV-fusion research separately. Archive PR34's complete native/optimized-libvpx results, including every regression and quality/workload limit. README and dependencies unchanged.

Exact-head native x64 results: EPYC 7763, Go 1.27.2, PGO off, six paired rounds versus main `9f333e01` and old assembly `691cd051`:
- All 18 oracle-bearing gather fixtures improve in every pair; minimum speedup 1.993x main. The 16 new fixtures show 8x8 2.075–2.087x main/0.998–1.001x assembly, and 16x16 2.008–2.016x main/0.950–0.954x assembly. Thus new 8x8 is near assembly parity and new 16x16 remains about 5% slower than assembly. Original 8x8/16x16 fixtures improve 2.169x/2.052x main and run at 1.060x/0.963x assembly. Preserve the legacy public-wrapper results too. Do not generalize ARM's assembly wins to all x64 cases.
- All 10 public picker fixtures improve in every pair, 1.082–1.355x main. Active cases remain approximately 0.7–4.9% slower than assembly by median; noop cases improve 1.608–1.698x over assembly. The 136-byte row-address stack scratch and cold stack-growth path in 16x16 gather coexist with zero reported steady-state kernel allocations and approximately 2x main speed; they are diagnostics, not a rejection criterion.
- Whole VP8 takes 7.659% less time than main in all six pairs (20.243 to 18.693 ms/input), and 20.790% less time than assembly in all six. This is a measured joint VP8 candidate result on EPYC 7763, not closure of previous ARM/other-x64 CPU gaps or an isolated gain attributed to either change alone.
- VP9 implementation timings are controls, but preserve their regressions: 320 takes 1.907% more time than main in all six pairs; 720 +0.688% (2/6 faster). They still take 38.210%/45.318% less time than assembly. No fix or causal explanation for these main-relative regressions is claimed.
- All 206 kernel cases have six samples per variant and zero B/op/allocs. Native validation passes 84 top-level tests plus six retained panic child probes (90 targeted checks; 118 PASS lines including subtests), no failures/skips. Three selected pixel GatherPointer tests and all three public ResidualGather tests pass; main/current SIMD dispatch is confirmed. All five recorded benchmark/production source hashes match exact HEAD.
- All 22 semantic fields match across three public and two profile datasets. Preserve the assembly VP9 720 allocation outlier: round 6 is 1.266667 allocations/input versus the usual 1.25. Every main/current allocation sample and every profile matches its dataset.
- Preserve all 77 median-regressing kernels, including nine all-six-slower results: SAD16x16 +7.595%, SplitSubpel8x4 +4.892%, quantizer batch25 +1.674%, batch16 +0.991%, Split8x16 +0.952%, vertical luma edge +0.892%, Split8x8 +0.769%, UV32/vertical/macro/smooth +0.305%, SSE16x16 +0.150%.
- Current independent VP8 profile samples the new fused vertical function at 0.11s flat/0.25s cumulative out of 2.23s total, proving production liveness. Existing loopFilterBytes records 0.02s/0.09s; Gather16PtrFast appears at 0.01s cumulative. Retain all profiles and hotspots; cumulative samples overlap and these short profiles do not isolate each component's throughput.

Separate optimized-C job on EPYC 9V45: pinned libvpx v1.16.0, runtime dispatch, SSE2/AVX2 and assembly objects enabled. Fixed-speed VP8 uses 2.416x libvpx time (+141.590%) with matching measured PSNR/SSIM/payload/encoded and dropped counts. This is measured-output agreement, not bitstream identity. Adaptive VP8 +64.142%, VP9 +173.243%/+189.981% perform unequal quality/output work. Every quality-pass output statistic matches its timed output; reference timer is vpxenc-stats. No absolute comparison or source-effect attribution across independent CPU jobs.

All three exact-head CI checks pass; native job completed in 19m50s. Raw artifacts: [native](https://github.com/thesyncim/govpx/actions/runs/39072236858/artifacts/12116077475), [optimized C](https://github.com/thesyncim/govpx/actions/runs/39072236858/artifacts/12115234913).
